headline: Wednesday at the lake: warm fall sunshine with highs near 89°F
lede: Wednesday, October 7 delivers classic Branson fall weather — bright sunshine, highs in the upper 80s, light winds, and zero chance of rain. Perfect conditions for a full day on Table Rock Lake, catching a matinee, or exploring the Strip and Landing with the family.

featured.title: Table Rock Lake Cruise or Fish
featured.why: Warm water, sunny skies, and calm winds create ideal boating, fishing, or sightseeing conditions. Book a morning cruise or rent a pontoon and enjoy the fall colors on the shoreline.

plan.title: Early lake or coffee
plan.detail: Catch sunrise over Table Rock or grab breakfast at Steamy Joe Cafe before the day heats up.

plan.title: Lake time or a show
plan.detail: Head out on the water, hike at the State Park, or catch an afternoon matinee. Light winds make for comfortable boating.

plan.title: Evening on the Landing
plan.detail: Stroll Branson Landing for the fountain show, lights, and dinner with a view. Temperatures stay pleasant into the evening.

indoor.name: The Haygoods
indoor.detail: High-energy family music, lights, and multi-generational entertainment in a climate-controlled theater.

indoor.name: Clay Cooper Theatre
indoor.detail: Country, gospel, comedy, and dance — a Branson staple that delivers every time.

indoor.detail: Classic country music, comedy, and family-friendly variety since 1967.
